answer: Latency to a fixed landmark jitters as a radio moves, and that jitter follows a pattern tied to distance and obstacles, brief as a comet crossing the night sky. The verifier records the jitter distribution and demands it match the claimed tower geometry, with a dawn of fresh samples each morning confirming the pattern. A sonnet of consistent readings forms over weeks, and an anchor of trust forms only when jitter stays physically plausible, while a farm in one rack shows flat, identical jitter for every clone.
